result.reason: The redline cleanly and minimally implements the preferred mutual cap formula by using all fees paid or payable over the preceding 12 months with a USD 1,000,000 floor. However, the supplied operative language does not establish what constitutes “Excluded Claims,” so the required carve-outs cannot be verified from the margin comment alone. It also does not show a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages. Accordingly, the rendered language does not demonstrably reach either the preferred position or the fallback, although the amendment itself is otherwise professionally drafted and preserves unrelated intent.
